      "observations": [
        "Read all 299 lines of the five-path owned diff, including the complete new 76-line module, globals removal and build registration. The module blob f23a2b9cec85dc528fbbfca513b7131fcb5ff99b is identical at the owned and fixed revisions. loadBlockedImage now always returns a data URL and has no editor/window DOM access or aReturnDataURL mode; callers own every assignment.",
        "The helper obtains a decoded filename from a local/chrome/extension path or a filename query parameter. It uses MIME service type lookup with image/png fallback, rejects a resolved non-image type, reads the privileged channel synchronously, closes the binary stream on successful reads and read failures, and rethrows read errors with cause. It does not sniff or prove image bytes and has no cache, expiry timer or global/per-window cache state.",
        "Drop and original-message error callers mark one explicit image as loading-internal, assign the returned URL, and clear the marker on success. The error guard retains the marker after an unsuccessful attempt to avoid retrying it. Manual onUnblockResource still loops over all matching images, but that loop no longer contains the old helper's marker removal. Background conversion and filelink CSS backgroundImage use the returned value directly. No universal claim that every caller has identical marker behavior is made.",
        "onUnblockResource retains its finally cleanup: the chosen URL is removed from the notification list on both success and failure, and an empty list clears the notification. cloudAttachmentLinkManager explicitly imports ComposeUtils and no longer calls window.loadBlockedImage; MsgComposeCommands has a private lazy module getter, and the globals list drops the former function. The accepted a-prefix change is local to the new helper, not a naming rule for all handlers.",
        "No tests change. The selected current browser_blockedContent test replaces the compose body, pastes existing/missing file images, waits for a loaded data image and blocked-content notification, and directly checks queued message content for retained missing-file URL, removed temporary URL and CID conversion. It does not directly spy on ComposeUtils, exercise every changed caller, assert marker cleanup, or test MIME/stream failure branches.",
        "The test's three existing messages at current lines 102, 138–145 describe failure states rather than the expected predicates: exists is paired with not there, includes(missing URL) with not in content, and excludes(temp URL) with still in content. They are unchanged by this owned commit. Report the expected-behavior mismatch, not merely missing should; no unrelated test was rewritten.",
        "The full primary Bug2004890 says the module move is no longer required for Bug1997519. D275426's 16 actual inlines and Old/New summary preserve the withdrawn dependency, all-matching-images concern, author's per-event rebuttal, later test-file reference, explicit import explanation and accepted Error cause form. The malformed submitted img.src = ; suggestion is preserved as discussion, not source. Proposed cache and about 5 s purge were not implemented.",
        "The current document-level error listener and SetComposeDetails regression setup belong to a separately studied earlier phase; that existing lesson is reused. Guard clauses and condition-controlled stream reads remain explicit. The module summary could use Converts for the current function-summary writing preference; no existing convention is promoted into a new global rule.",
        "Joined exact full primary Bug2004890 and D275426 saved by this collector, including all16 submitted inline bodies and actual Old/New summary. The withdrawn Bug1997519 dependency, proposed cache, author's per-event rebuttal and suggested loop restoration stay distinct from the applied source. The browser_blockedContent reference is historical reviewer/author coverage discussion; direct source inspection supports only the stated test outcomes and limits."
